Chat Edit: '✅ Fix imports

Since you now have folders:

proto/kv
proto/raft


Do this:

In all Go files that import kv proto:

Replace:

"github.com/siddharth-roy27/distributed-kv-store/proto"


or

"github.com/siddharth-roy27/distributed-kv-store/proto/kvpb"


With:

"github.com/siddharth-roy27/distributed-kv-store/proto/kv"

In all Go files that import raft proto:

Replace:

"github.com/siddharth-roy27/distributed-kv-store/proto/raftpb"


With:

"github.com/siddharth-roy27/distributed-kv-store/proto/raft"'

Chat Edit: '✅ Error 1
cannot use e.Command (type interface{}) as string


Check this file:

internal/raft/client.go


Find this line (~53):

Command: e.Command,


Your proto requires a string in the LogEntry type:

message LogEntry {
    int64 term = 1;
    string command = 2;
}


But e.Command is interface{}.

✅ Fix:

Convert it to string:

Command: fmt.Sprintf("%v", e.Command),'
